decisions.reason: J_LED_CHG and its CHGLED circuitry are distinct from the J_BAT battery connector, whose family, pinout, placement, and unresolved labeling remain unchanged.
Adding J_LED_CHG does not explicitly change any current board dimensions, mounting constraints, enclosure-fit rules, or battery-connector arrangement.
The CHGLED connector and R6 changes do not affect the boost converter enable GPIO, pull-down, switched supply, or sensor operating mode.
The source changes the charge-status output circuitry but does not alter the candidate's VMID/VSYS connection or VSYS labeling requirements.
The new JST-GH charge-status connector is separate from the USB-C connector and does not change the USB connector or sourcing requirements.
The source does not change battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal, or other protection behavior.
The CHGLED circuit changes do not alter the battery NTC sensing method or its J_BAT connection.
The connector and resistor changes do not modify the selected eight-layer stack.
The source contains no change to the power board's TVS-based ESD protection.

J_LED_CHG may constitute an additional interboard signal connection, but the source does not identify its destination, pin functions, or whether it belongs to the existing interboard-link architecture.
R6 is identified as part of the CHGLED circuit, not the retained I2C series resistors or I2C pull-up configuration.
The source concerns a charge-status LED connection and does not change the separate board containing 16 addressable LEDs.
